title: Hiba Hospital (Amman, maternity & gynaecology) — doctors page + facility pages
notes: The site claims 50+ doctors but its doctors page publishes only 4 profiles; all 4 captured. Arabic only: ?lang=En returns the same Arabic HTML (language is client/cookie side), so no name_en. Profiles give name, department and a one-line position; no specialty field set (position kept in extra.position_ar). Accreditations are from home-page badges ('JCI Standards', 'ISO 9001', MoH) with no year/status detail. Contact page mobiles are the hospital's published lines.
